More Than a Workout: How the CrossFit Community Rewires Identity

We don't change our habits through willpower alone; we change them by changing who we surround ourselves with. Decades of research show health behaviors spread through social ties almost like contagion, and CrossFit's group structure puts that mechanism to work by design. This piece breaks down the science behind why the community isn't just a nice bonus; it's doing real, measurable work.
